key_insight: A conditional quantum prior learns parameter-dependent statistics of chaotic dynamics and regularizes classical predictors without retraining at unseen parameter values within the training range.
engineering_relevance: Shared quantum priors could reduce parameter-specific model overhead while improving classical fluid predictors’ long-term statistical fidelity.
method: Condition a quantum generative prior on a system parameter to approximate selected invariant-measure statistics.
Use the learned prior to regularize classical neural-network autoregressive rollouts.
Implement a photonic quantum prior targeting NISQ devices.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 56.9% lower mean Jensen–Shannon divergence than a comparable-weight classical MLP across 96 unseen Lorenz-63 parameter values, and 66.0% lower 318-step forecast MSE for Kolmogorov flow at Re=1000 versus an unregularized classical baseline.
watch_item: Generalization is demonstrated within the training parameter range; extrapolation and end-to-end quantum computational advantage are not established.
paper_title: Conditional Quantum Priors for Chaotic Fluid Dynamics
